creator: Alexander Terp
description:
RED-9 shipped in `f799ba47`; the scripts that predate it still carry the old idiom. Deferred deliberately from that work, not forgotten.

`rad check` finds the mechanical cases:

```shell
rad check --from-logs all
```

A sweep of `~/src/scripts/bin` (43 scripts) found **45 RAD40023 hits across 15 files**. Each is an interpolation wrapped in quotes the script wrote itself; those quotes now land inside the argument. Two of the three shapes are a two-character fix:

1. `"{x}"` or `'{x}'` alone -> delete the quotes.
2. `"literal text {x}"` -> hoist into a variable, then interpolate that. e.g. `tm:18` `mkdir -p "{trash_dir}"`, `tm:33` `mv -f "{info.full_path}" "{dest}"`.

**The part the diagnostic cannot find** is the more important half: commands assembled into a string and run with `$cmd`. RED-9 left that form raw by design, so it neither warns nor changed behavior - but it is where the remaining quoting bugs live. Six of the nine `$cmd` sites interpolate a real value: `ytdl:9,11`, `fn:15`, `trim:17,20,23,31`, `fe:14`, `gwho:11`, `mp3bigadjust:22`. Convert these to list commands:

```rad
cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-i", path]
if start:
    cmd += ["-ss", start]
$cmd
```

**Worth doing while in there**, since RED-9 makes each strictly better code:

- `fr:30-31` - `sh_quote` and its 5 call sites can go; Rad quotes now.
- `dev:8` and `ct:90` - `get_args()[1:].join(" ")` destroys any argument with a space. Interpolating the list directly fixes it.
- `benchmark/benchmark.rad:26` - `join(scripts, "' '", "'", "'")` is a hand-rolled shell quoter written as a join. Now just `{scripts}`.
- `sayy:8`, `remind:372` - `remind` currently *deletes* apostrophes from user text to survive quoting.
- `svalbard/backup.rad:67` - the `--files-from-verbatim` temp-file dance exists only because a list could not be passed as N arguments.
- `.kan/hooks/type-shortcut.rad` - replicated across 30+ repos, and the one that interpolates third-party card titles into a command.

### Watch out for

Scripts here are on PATH and used daily. Change them in small batches and run each one, rather than sweeping all 15 files at once - the `$cmd` conversions are real rewrites, not a find-replace.
title: 🧹 Migrate the script corpus onto RED-9 shell quoting
